verify_r61_review.py.description: Standard-library deterministic audit and exact rational spot check

blocking_findings: The root-free exact-search theorem remains specialized to scalar rational action lattices and analytically integrated one-layer affine-ReLU objectives with piecewise-quartic structure.
Common-only is the fastest complete warm service in all 24 matched service groups and has the same target-attainment pattern as every fitted method.
No direct expected-policy-cost interval identifies a lower native-ReLU cost than common-only or native quadratic; the nonidentity comparisons remain unresolved.
Large native query-level savings shrink to a median complete-service saving of about 1.36 percent relative to screened ReLU, with two complete-service reversals.
The exact witness changes local cells but has no identified complete-policy cost benefit relative to the strongest conventional generators.
Original-optimum accuracy is executed only for the two-state, two-date economy; none of the five actually returned actors reaches the one-sixteenth tolerance.
The centered Bellman result is a separately frozen follow-up designed after the uncentered failure, not a prospective multi-cell validation of the NBO service family.
The multi-action extension is query-only and adaptive subdivision is slower than exhaustive search in every deposited record, with exact fallbacks in larger cases.
Training reliability, high-dimensional Bellman accuracy, general shock laws, difficult action dimensions and hardware-general performance remain unestablished.
The 91-page article, 58-page active supplement and extensive companions remain disproportionate to the focused exact-search and low-dimensional certification result.

compact_publication_audit_artifact.note: Compact audit artifact from the publication attempt; completed canonical publication status is established by FINAL_DELIVERY61.json at the reviewed commit.

limitations: The reviewer did not retrain, resimulate, rebuild the publication, or retime services; new executions would create new observations.
The reviewer verified frozen records, hashes and aggregate arithmetic and spot-checked the central discrete-curvature lemma, but did not independently re-prove every inherited theorem.
Worker repetitions reuse the same mathematical policies and statistical streams and are not independent economic observations.
Single-host and hosted-worker timings are descriptive and support no hardware-general inference.
This advisory review is not an Econometric Society editorial decision.
positive_findings: R61 is a canonical, complete and cleanly reproducible review-ready submission.
The root-free discrete-curvature theorem removes the favorable-separation premise and preserves flat objectives and exact ties.
The fresh native two-by-two factorial isolates activation reduction from the search algorithm in one rational engine.
The stress catalogue includes cancellation, crossing, exact ties, flatness, coarse bounds and charged fallbacks.
The uniform-box integration and constrained-lattice theorem provide a correct non-scalar witness extension with explicit worst-case costs.
The fixed-cover stability lemma closes a real gap between interval inclusion and recursive error propagation.
The common-reference Bellman calculation and paid fixed-policy revalidation address the original optimum and actual returned actors separately.
Strong conventional controls, failed targets, timing reversals and unresolved economic comparisons are preserved.
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not invite another ordinary revision of the cumulative manuscript. A new, sharply focused paper on exact root-free action recovery and stable Bellman certification for analytically integrated neural continuations could merit evaluation after the numerical contribution is isolated, demonstrated at matched original-optimum accuracy, and shown to improve a substantive economic decision relative to strong conventional methods.
